theFindings.theA3Point: The refusal a lane was recently right to record is the refusal to read that fee across to § 99-15-59, which is a DIFFERENT statute. § 99-19-71(4) is the same statute, and the sibling family ms-fel-set states the $150 for § 99-19-71(2) with the reasoning printed on its own page: 'This petition is a petition to expunge an offense under Sec. 99-19-71, so the fee applies to it on the face of the statute.'

The assignment says in terms that a repair lane must fix the fee and must NOT import the service rule.

theFindings.finding: On the pardon route the packet prints, under 'WHAT IT COSTS, AND WHETHER A WAIVER EXISTS', a county-dependent fee and a waiver to apply for — six lines after the same component states that NRS 179.273 is titled 'Sealing of records after unconditional pardon: Automatic sealing; petition; no fee' and that the petition carries no fee. The packet contradicts itself on one page, under the heading a participant reads to learn what filing costs.
theFindings.scopedNotBlanket: The other five routes' fee cells are correct: county-dependent is the registry's own answer for those tracks and NV-nevada.json feeRules is empty, so it is not a delegation of an answered fact.

theFindings.finding: participant-instructions.md has no self-help stopping-point section at all. The registry records eight conditions for ut_pet_acquittal and the packet states none of them as a stop. 'The participant is not a US citizen', which the registry marks a hard stop because the FBI may retain records of an expunged case, is absent — the words 'citizen' and 'immigration' appear zero times in the instructions and zero times in the packet bytes — while the packet's own SERVICE section states that BCI forwards a copy of the order to the FBI. One condition is inverted: the registry ends self-help where the court schedules a hearing; the packet says 'if the court schedules a hearing, attend it.'

On packet page 18 the participant's name is written across the printed 'I' opening the BCI declaration, in both fixtures. Canonical: written box x 50.50-81.07 y 385.82-395.07 against printed 'I' at x 49.74-52.74 y 388.53-400.66 — 2.24pt horizontally across a 6.54pt band. Boundary: 2.24pt across 5.86pt.

theFindings.finding: 24 caption court blanks across 50 pages, registered in none of the 410 field-map rows, with a parenthetical beneath naming the district attorney's or city attorney's office — the route's destination — where the court, its venue, belongs. theCorrectRefusalsRecordedSoTheyAreNotUn.why: DE-delaware.json feeRules states '$70' for the discretionary petition under 11 Del. C. §§ 4374 / 4375, which is the ADULT Superior Court route. This family is 10 Del. C. § 1018, a juvenile Family Court petition. Reading $70 across from title 11 to title 10 is the cross-statute read A3 forbids. A repair lane must NOT close this by importing the $70.

DE-delaware.json serviceAndNoticeRules says a copy is served on the Attorney General who has 120 days to object, but the same sentence requires the SBI criminal-history report, which is the adult § 4374 attachment. The profile's own juvenile pathway entry carries no service rule. The packet correctly imports the route-native AG 120-day WINDOW from its own bound contract, and correctly refuses the adult-track service RECIPIENT. Two facts, two right answers.

SD-south-dakota.json holds a $72 filing fee and an indigency waiver, both cited to SDCL § 23a-3-28, whose own text in the same passage says the motion can only be made on a record of arrest. This route is § 26-7A-115.1, a juvenile trafficking expungement vacating a delinquency proceeding. A repair lane must NOT import the $72 or the § 23a-3-28 indigency waiver.

The same § 23a-3-28 scoping applies to the State's Attorney 14-day service rule and the UJS-393/UJS-395 steps. Importing them into a juvenile trafficking petition would invent a participant obligation.

The bound route contract carries no service recipient or method; MS-mississippi.json serviceAndNoticeRules is empty; § 99-19-71(2)(b)'s ten days' notice to the district attorney belongs to subsection (2). This refusal is correct even though the FEE refusal on the same family is not.

This is the family the record answers and the packet answers: $150 under § 99-19-72 with its $100/$40/$10 distribution, the open question about justice and municipal courts stated as open, an instruction to confirm with the clerk, and a waiver answer that delegates only the genuinely unestablished pauper's-affidavit question. It is the model the failing MS sibling should be repaired to.

notMeasured: No page raster. This container resolves no browser, so nothing in this return is a visual review. Every geometric statement is glyph-box arithmetic on the PDF text layer, not a rendered pixel. A defect visible only in raster — a wrong font, a missing glyph, an invisible white-on-white write — would not appear here.

pdftotext word boxes carry font ascender and descender padding, so vertical intersection between adjacent lines is normal typography. I did not report it as a defect, which means a genuine 1-2pt vertical collision between two lines of body text would be indistinguishable from padding in my instrument. The Utah finding survives this because it is a horizontal overlap between a written value and a printed glyph, which padding cannot produce.
